name: Shiratori Miyuki
source:
She is the only daughter of Chizuru and works as a cook at a ryokan. She follows in the footsteps of her father, who was a devoted cook, and works in the kitchen.

She is a firm woman and often assists the calm Chizuru. She tries her best to support her mother, who is becoming unstable after the loss of her husband.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onsenokami/index.html]official site[/url]]
